firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hi all,

In line with the competition rules on public code sharing, here is the code behind my Paper Track writeup:

https://github.com/danielmantiglia/codegraph-loc (Apache-2.0)

What it contains:

- A code-graph generator built on Python's `ast` module. It covers async functions and module-level code, adds typed edges (`calls`, `contains`, `imports`, `inherits`), and exports to the same node-link JSON schema and id convention as the released graphs.
- Function-level gold labels computed from diffs, and a localization benchmark built from public git history (fastapi, rich, requests, httpx), plus a held-out set from SWE-bench Lite and pymatgen.
- Scripts that reproduce every number and figure in the writeup.

Quick start:

```
pip install "git+https://github.com/danielmantiglia/codegraph-loc"
```

```python
import json
from cgl import build_graph, to_node_link
from cgl.graph import official_view

G = build_graph("path/to/repo")
json.dump(to_node_link(official_view(G)), open("graph.json", "w"))
```

No competition data is redistributed: the repository contains code, labels built from public history and aggregate statistics only.

Feedback and issues are welcome.
